software.name: DimeStack
software.description: Track ledgers, budgets, recurring transactions, goals, and net worth.

/.title: DimeStack — Personal finance tracker
/.description: Track income, expenses, budgets, goals, and net worth across multiple ledgers with DimeStack.
/.h1: Track every dollar in one quiet place
/.intro: DimeStack is a personal finance tracker for people who want clear ledgers, honest charts, and a record they can export.
/.keywords: finance tracker ledger budget net worth goals

/about.title: About DimeStack
/about.description: DimeStack is a personal finance tracker for households and freelancers who want a clear ledger.
/about.intro: DimeStack keeps income, expenses, budgets, and net worth in ledgers that stay easy to read.

/privacy.title: Privacy policy — DimeStack
/privacy.description: How DimeStack stores ledgers, session cookies, email addresses, and campaign parameters from your visit.
/privacy.intro: This policy describes the account data, finance records, cookies, and campaign parameters DimeStack keeps.

/security.title: Security at DimeStack
/security.description: DimeStack hashes passwords, keeps sessions in HTTP-only cookies, verifies email, and limits sign-in attempts.
/security.intro: Sign-in is rate limited, passwords are hashed, and each person can only read their own ledgers.

/login.title: Log in — DimeStack
/login.description: Sign in to your DimeStack ledgers with email or Google.
/login.intro: Use the email on your account, or continue with Google if you linked it.

/register.title: Create your DimeStack account
/register.description: Open a DimeStack account to track income, expenses, goals, and net worth.
/register.intro: You will get a personal ledger, cash and bank accounts, and a starter set of categories.

/forgot-password.title: Forgot password — DimeStack
/forgot-password.description: Request a password reset code or a secure link for your DimeStack account.
/forgot-password.intro: We will email a 6-digit code and a secure link that expire in 15 minutes.

/reset-password.title: Choose a new password — DimeStack
/reset-password.description: Set a new DimeStack password with the reset code or the secure link from your email.
/reset-password.intro: Paste the 6-digit code from the email, or open the link that already includes a token.

/verify-email.title: Verify your email — DimeStack
/verify-email.description: Confirm your email address before recording transactions in DimeStack.
/verify-email.intro: Open the verification link from your inbox, or paste the page you were sent.

/search.title: Search DimeStack
/search.description: Search DimeStack pages and, when you are signed in, your transactions, ledgers, and goals.
/search.intro: Look through the public guides and, if you are signed in, your own records.

/app.title: Dashboard — DimeStack
/app.description: See income, expenses, balance over time, and how transactions are distributed.
/app.intro: A summary of the selected ledger for the dates you choose.

/app/ledgers.title: Ledgers — DimeStack
/app/ledgers.description: Create separate ledgers for household, freelance, or travel money.
/app/ledgers.intro: Each ledger keeps its own transactions and a default cash account.

/app/transactions.title: Transactions — DimeStack
/app/transactions.description: Record, search, filter, edit, import, and export income and expenses.
/app/transactions.intro: Enter an amount, a description, and whether the money came in or went out.

/app/budgets.title: Monthly budgets — DimeStack
/app/budgets.description: Set a monthly budget for each expense category and compare it with spending.
/app/budgets.intro: Pick a month, choose a category, and set the amount you intend to spend.

/app/recurring.title: Recurring transactions — DimeStack
/app/recurring.description: Schedule income and expenses that repeat each week, month, or year.
/app/recurring.intro: DimeStack records a due schedule the next time you open your books.

/app/goals.title: Financial goals — DimeStack
/app/goals.description: Set a savings goal and record contributions until you reach the target.
/app/goals.intro: Name a target, set a deadline if you have one, and add money as you save it.

/app/net-worth.title: Net worth — DimeStack
/app/net-worth.description: Track assets, liabilities, account transfers, and net worth over time.
/app/net-worth.intro: Net worth is the total of your asset accounts minus what your liability accounts owe.

/app/reports.title: Reports — DimeStack
/app/reports.description: Compare income, expenses, and savings across months, then download a PDF.
/app/reports.intro: Review a date range, compare months, and download the same summary as a PDF.

/app/categories.title: Categories — DimeStack
/app/categories.description: Organize income and expenses with categories and subcategories.
/app/categories.intro: Top-level categories group your charts. Subcategories keep the ledger more specific.

/app/profile.title: Profile — DimeStack
/app/profile.description: Update your name, phone, currency, time zone, bio, and password.
/app/profile.intro: These details appear on your reports and control how amounts are displayed.

/app/sessions.title: Active sessions — DimeStack
/app/sessions.description: Review devices signed in to DimeStack and log out of the ones you do not recognize.
/app/sessions.intro: Each sign-in keeps its own session. You can end one device or every device.

/404.title: Page not found — DimeStack
/404.description: This DimeStack address does not match a page. Search the site or return home.
/404.h1: This page is not on DimeStack
/404.intro: The link may be out of date. Try search, or go back to the home page.
